Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a chemical company based at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017, serving customers who demand reliability, responsiveness, and technical rigor. Positioned in the heart of New York City, the company engages with partners across the broader life sciences and specialty manufacturing ecosystems, supporting projects that range from early-stage development to scaled commercial needs. 

Standardpharm focuses on delivering consistent quality, dependable supply, and attentive customer service. Its team emphasizes clear communication, timely project updates, and flexible solutions tailored to each client’s specifications. Whether the requirement is a specialized intermediate, a fine chemical, or support for formulation and scale-up, the company aims to simplify complex supply chains and help customers meet demanding timelines.

Quality and safety are central to Standardpharm’s approach. The company prioritizes robust documentation, process discipline, and compliance with applicable regulations, helping clients manage risk while maintaining efficient operations. Equally important is a commitment to responsible practices, including careful material stewardship and continuous improvement in environmental, health, and safety performance.

Collaboration is a defining aspect of Standardpharm’s work. The company partners closely with technical teams, procurement groups, and operational leaders to align on requirements, optimize specifications, and anticipate downstream needs. This collaborative model supports smoother technology transfer, stronger supply continuity, and better outcomes for end users.

With its New York presence and customer-first mindset, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. provides a dependable platform for organizations seeking a capable, service-oriented chemical partner for development, sourcing, and ongoing production.
